# DeftSuite

> The lean team's enterprise toolkit. DeftSuite runs the security review, the policies behind it, the support portal after signature, and agents that keep all three current, for founder-led B2B teams selling to enterprise.

## Products and status

Win:
- DeftRevenue: quotes, proposals and accounts. Early access.
- DeftMarketing: site content, approvals and newsletters. In build.
- DeftDemo: product walkthroughs replayed from the real app. In build.

Pass review:
- DeftTrust: SOC 2 controls with their evidence attached. Early access.
- DeftDocs: policies and procedures, approved and versioned. In build.
- DeftInfra: a change record for every environment and secret. In build.
- Sentinel: external uptime monitoring. Early access.

Keep:
- DeftDesk: customer support portal and published documentation. Available.

Do the work:
- DeftAgents: agents that draft, file and follow up, with every action approved and logged. Early access.

## Pricing

Flat monthly price by team size. Every product included. No per-seat charges, no add-ons.

- 1 to 9 people: $99 per month
- 10 to 19 people: $249 per month
- 20 or more people: $499 per month
